name: Better Be Cool
tagline: Air conditioning installed properly, across London
description: F-Gas certified air conditioning installation for London homes and businesses. Fixed written quotes, guide prices published up front, most single-room systems fitted in a day.

credentials.label: F-Gas certified
credentials.detail: Every engineer holds C&G 2079 - a legal requirement to handle refrigerant in the UK.

credentials.label: REFCOM registered
credentials.detail: Company registration for refrigerant handling and record keeping.

credentials.label: Part P electrical
credentials.detail: Our own electricians do the circuit work and self-certify it.

credentials.label: £5m public liability
credentials.detail: Fully insured, with employers' liability cover for our engineers.

credentials.label: Manufacturer approved
credentials.detail: Daikin, Mitsubishi Electric, Panasonic and LG trained and warranty-approved.

credentials.label: Free written quotes
